note: A13.17: a Django models.Model with no Meta.db_table and no Meta.app_label (its Meta sets only ordering). Django's implicit table is <app_label>_<lowercased model>; the app label comes from the module path (shop/models.py -> shop), the part no string scanner can derive. Identity follows A13.1: the entity is keyed on the MODEL (data_entity:sql:Order) at the declaration and at the query site in another file, and the derived table rides a CODE table cell {table, orm: django} at the declaration only.

expect_edges.note: Order.objects.filter in views.py, a different file from the model
the model CLASS defines its entity at the declaration site

expect_cells.note: implicit <app_label>_<model>, app label from the module path

forbid.note: declaration and query site are ONE model-keyed node; a table-keyed second id would orphan the query
